hero.title: A Vite starter without the framework tax
hero.subtitle: Plain JavaScript templating, Tailwind CSS v4, i18next and Vitest — wired together and nothing more.

build.title: Vite build
build.body: Multi-page by default: one entry per HTML file, hashed assets sorted by type, and a bundle report behind npm run analyze.

styles.title: Tailwind CSS v4
styles.body: Configured from CSS with @theme. No PostCSS chain, no Autoprefixer, no preprocessor to install.

i18n.title: i18next
i18n.body: The fallback language is bundled, so the first paint has real text; other languages load over HTTP.

quality.title: Quality gates
quality.body: ESLint, Prettier, type-checked JSDoc and Vitest run on every commit and in CI.

demo.hint: Type your name: the region re-renders on every keystroke, and the caret stays put.
demo.label: Your name

about.title: Adding a page
about.body: This template is multi-page by default: no client-side router, no history API, just another HTML entry point.

steps.html: Create about.html next to index.html and point its script at a new entry module.
steps.entry: Create src/about.js, import startApp from the shared bootstrap, and pass it the page content.
steps.input: Register the HTML file under build.rollupOptions.input in vite.config.js.
